$comment: Balance data for engine.leisure (MOD-055). §42/§5.1 describe the 168-hour weekly budget, the personality-weighted venue allocation, novelty decay, the openings pipeline, and the events calendar only by DIRECTION and mechanism — they give NO numeric magnitude for the baseline work/education/sleep/chore hours, the access-time thresholds, the overtime wage rate, the novelty-decay rates, the event crowd sizes, or the match threshold. Every number here is a PLACEHOLDER pending the M2 balance pass (GR#15's balance-number regime: player-felt numbers are placeholders + directional tests until Aaron rules). The one spec-stated magnitude is hoursPerWeek = 168 (transcribed from §42's '168 − work − sleep − chores − commute'). lifeStages is keyed by LifeStage.String() and defaultPopulationTaste is keyed by the venue-category names; both maps are only ever ACCESSED by key (never ranged), so JSON object-key order is irrelevant to determinism (GR#21).
